_comment: Machine-scope (host-global) skill registry — shared once across every project on the machine, installed at the host level, never per-repo. source_fetched entries: SETUP fetches each from its canonical public repo at install (always latest); single source of truth — the blueprint never holds a copy of these registry skills that can silently drift; refresh/export MUST NOT re-vendor them, it only maintains this list. Moved here from templates/project/skills/sources.json (ghostwriter, vision-factory) — that file keeps only project-scope entries.
